items.title: Create return quote: Keystone Home & Garden - Texas Division
items.summary: TL dry van Fort Worth, TX -> Columbus, OH, sell $3,629.17 at 16.0% GP
items.reasoning: Keystone's Texas Division receives 11 loads a month from Columbus and is set up as a shipper. Dry vans arriving in Fort Worth carried patio furniture, so no washout is needed. Priced at 16% GP because this is a new lane for the customer.
